verdicts.evidence: lines 623-654: filter chips, sort headers, Refresh, banner Try again, clear search, row actions, empty-state buttons and dialog buttons (340-345) all have listeners that change state or call the api and re-render

lines 383-385: rows come from api.listInvoices; stats (577-582), chip counts (586-589) and count (599-601) are computed from state.invoices; zero records shows 'No invoices yet' (546). No hardcoded figures
lines 348, 431-453: each confirmation dialog shows the invoice number, customer and amount it concerns; the second-reminder dialog states when the previous reminder was sent (442)
The only input is one single-line search field (174); no multi-step task, no long free text. Search and status filter are kept in the URL anyway (308-314)

line 326: focus goes to the confirm button unless opts.danger, so Enter confirms 'Mark as paid' (body says it cannot be undone from this screen, 434) and 'Send again' (a second email, 442). Only the delete dialog defaults to Cancel

lines 506-508: mark paid, send reminder and delete are buttons in the table row; search and status filter are on the same screen (171-177). The one extra step, the mark-paid dialog (431-437), guards a change with no way back

Brief names find, see overdue, mark paid, remind, delete draft. Added without a named task: 'Sent, awaiting payment' total (166, 582), column sorting and sort select (180-187, 527), Refresh button and 'Updated' time (188, 596)

line 507: 'Mark paid' is rendered with class 'primary' (filled accent, line 57) in every sent and overdue row, so the table view shows many primary-styled buttons; the rule's exception requires row actions to be secondary

lines 323, 60: in the delete dialog 'Delete permanently' gets 'danger-solid', a filled bold button and the only filled one beside a plain Cancel, so it is styled as the prominent action. Focus does start on Cancel (326) and the row Delete is outlined (508)

lines 494, 503-504: row buttons are disabled only while that row's request is in flight, with a busy label; Refresh is disabled only while refreshing (594-595). Actions that do not apply to a status are not rendered (506-508)
No title attributes, tooltips or hover cards anywhere in the markup or script
Visible strings (161-198, 410-422, 432-451, 546-555, 572) refer only to invoices, payments, reminders and the server not responding; nothing about the build, framework, request or mocked data

Notices sit at their decision: dialog bodies (434, 442, 450) next to the confirm buttons, 'Reminder sent ...' under the Remind again button (510), refresh-failure banner with Try again (396). No standing callouts
No text narrates the interface. The only guidance is one line in the no-match state, 'Check the spelling, or try the invoice number, for example NW-2041.' (551), at the search it concerns

line 554: heading 'No overdue invoices' is followed by 'Nothing is overdue right now.', and 'No draft invoices' by 'There is nothing with this status at the moment.'; each description restates its heading
Heading is 'Invoices' (162); no greeting, slogan, superlative or exclamation mark in any string (410-422, 432-451, 546-555, 572)

Labels: 'Send reminder', 'Remind again', 'Mark paid', 'Delete' (506-508, object given by the row and aria-label 504), 'Mark as paid', 'Send again', 'Delete permanently', 'Try again', 'Clear search', 'Show all invoices', 'Refresh'. No OK, Yes or Submit

line 252, 518: status values are mapped to 'Draft', 'Sent', 'Paid', 'Overdue'; internal ids (inv_9000) are only in attributes, never shown; column heads are Invoice, Customer, Issued, Due, Amount, Status (530)
lines 410, 416, 422, 572, 396: messages name the problem and outcome ('Couldn't reach the server, so no reminder was sent. Try again.'). The raw ECONNRESET error is caught (482) and never displayed
Error strings (396, 410, 416, 422, 572) use 'Couldn't load', 'Couldn't reach the server'; no 'failed', 'invalid', 'oops', exclamation marks or capitals, and none blames the user

lines 545-547: with zero invoices the panel shows 'No invoices yet' and one line, with no action at all; toolbar including Refresh is hidden in that state (565). Filtered-empty states do offer actions (552, 555)

Distinct states: nothing exists 'No invoices yet' (546); search matched nothing with 'Clear search' / 'Show all matches' (550-552); status matched nothing with 'Show all invoices' (554-555); load failure with 'Try again' (572)

Initial load failure renders an error state with Try again (393-394, 572). Refresh failure keeps the list and shows a banner with Try again (395-397). Action failure puts a message in the row and keeps the row and its button (483-485, 511)

lines 378-380, 570: skeleton rows render at once on load. Row buttons show 'Marking paid...', 'Sending...', 'Deleting...' (504); Refresh shows 'Refreshing...' (595). Worst case is 3 tries of 1.5s, under ten seconds

lines 564-570: in phase 'loading' the toolbar, count and stats are hidden and only the skeleton renders; emptyHtml is reached only in phase 'ready' (603-605). Refreshes keep the previous rows on screen (378)

line 83: customer cell wraps with overflow-wrap anywhere; amounts and dates are nowrap with tabular figures (84-85); null reminderSentAt is handled (506, 510); stats show 'None' when empty (579); unknown status falls back (518)
No edits are held on screen for an explicit save; every action is sent as soon as it is confirmed (457-462)
The only field is the search box (174), which accepts any text and matches loosely (351-358)
No data-entry form; the single search field is neither required nor optional
No input validation exists; search filters as typed and shows no errors (644)
No form that can reject input
No form that can be rejected
No form that can reject input
No data-entry form with a submit button; the dialog form (208) holds only confirm and cancel buttons

line 428: act returns if the invoice already has a pending action; 458 sets pending before the request; 494, 503-504 render the row's buttons disabled with a busy label until the response; the modal blocks a second click while confirming

Row actions open a dialog synchronously (325) or set pending and render a busy label before awaiting (458-460); search, filter and sort re-render in the same tick (617-622); Refresh turns to 'Refreshing...' at once (379-380, 595)

lines 476-479: on success the row is replaced with the server result and kept in place (badge turns Paid, 'Reminder sent ...' note appears); a deleted row is removed (469). On failure a message is added to the row (484, 511)

line 481: every success raises a toast (409, 415, 421) although the result is already visible in place: the badge changes to Paid, the 'Reminder sent today at ...' note appears in the row (510), and the deleted row disappears

Errors are inline in the row and stay until the next attempt (484, 459, 511), or in a banner hidden only on a successful load (390, 396-397). The only auto-dismissing messages are success toasts with no action (296-302)
The server offers no way to restore any of the three actions: no unmark-paid, no recall of a reminder, and deletion is permanent (brief; api at 239-242)

line 438: a first 'Send reminder' emails the customer on a single click with no confirmation (only a repeat is confirmed), and it cannot be recalled. Delete is confirmed by name with 'permanently' and focus on Cancel (446-453)

lines 431-437: a confirmation guards 'Mark paid', the team's frequent everyday action, which the rule forbids; but the change has no way back on this server, which argues for asking. The two readings give different verdicts
lines 458-480: nothing is changed on screen ahead of the server; the row only shows a busy state and is updated from the response
lines 207-217, 316-326: the one modal holds a single confirm or cancel decision with the invoice's facts, and opens only from a row button click (431, 439, 447)

line 325: native dialog opened with showModal, so focus is trapped and Escape closes (close handler 342); focus is set inside on open (326) and returned to the opener on close (324, 337); a visible Cancel exists (213)

lines 159-201: after a one-line heading come search and status filters, then the invoice table, which fills the panel. The two totals sit small at the right of the heading row (35-38) and do not push the table down
lines 159-163: the page opens with 'Northwind accounts' and the heading 'Invoices', then the toolbar and table; no hero, greeting or intro panel

lines 166, 582: the 'Sent, awaiting payment' count and total informs none of the brief's tasks and is not a link to anything; the Overdue total (165, 581) repeats the count already on the Overdue filter chip (586-589)

Active status shows as a pressed chip (588), the query stays in the search box, and the count reads 'Showing 5 of 46 invoices' (599-601). There is no single clear-all: search and status are cleared separately (648, the All chip) unless the list is empty

All controls are native buttons, an input and a select (174-188, 503, 527, 588); the dialog is native (325); focus is restored after re-render and after delete (465-474, 608-613); '/' focuses search (655-662). No click-only elements

line 518: status badges carry the words Draft, Sent, Paid, Overdue; overdue rows add 'N days overdue' text (498); row errors are sentences (511); sort direction is an arrow plus aria-sort (525-527); pressed chips have aria-pressed (588)

lines 204-205: toast container role=status and an alert region exist on load and are filled later (300, 303-307); the count is role=status (197); the banner is role=alert (191); row failures are announced through the alert region (486)
No accordions, disclosure buttons, menus, comboboxes or tabs; status filters are toggle buttons with aria-pressed (588) and sorting on small screens is a native select (180)

lines 121-154: under 760px rows become stacked cards with full-width 44px action buttons, search is full width, filter chips scroll horizontally (48), a sort select replaces the hidden headers (131), and the dialog is capped to the viewport with stacked buttons (108, 152-153)
